title: GitHub authority-freeze/provider feasibility

verdict.reason: The live ruleset has RepositoryRole actor 5 in always bypass mode; the authenticated caller is repository and organization admin. Documented ruleset/ref APIs expose no old-state/base-SHA CAS. A cooperating lease or proxy cannot fence an admin's direct provider call.

documented_mechanisms.guarantee: Sets target sha; force=false requires fast-forward.
documented_mechanisms.limit: No documented expected-old-SHA/base-SHA precondition; read-then-update races.

documented_mechanisms.guarantee: Blocks force pushes for actors subject to the ruleset.
documented_mechanisms.limit: Does not constrain bypass actors or unwanted fast-forward writes.

documented_mechanisms.guarantee: Only users with bypass permission may update matching refs.
documented_mechanisms.limit: An administrator able to edit the ruleset can change this guard; compatible merge actor must be proven.

documented_mechanisms.guarantee: Can gate matching refs on checks and a specified workflow path/ref/repository/sha.
documented_mechanisms.limit: Not an old-ref/base-SHA CAS; current ruleset uses bare contexts and no workflow rule.

documented_mechanisms.guarantee: Rejects when supplied sha does not match PR head.
documented_mechanisms.limit: Guards PR head only; no base SHA.

documented_mechanisms.guarantee: Accepts base branch and head branch or commit SHA.
documented_mechanisms.limit: Base is a mutable branch name; no base-SHA precondition.

documented_mechanisms.guarantee: Tests queued changes against latest target branch and queued PRs.
documented_mechanisms.limit: Not exact earlier base; requires merge_group checks; absent from live protect-main; bypass remains a limit.

documented_mechanisms.guarantee: Admin-capable caller can replace full ruleset object.
documented_mechanisms.limit: No documented version/expected-current hash/CAS field or header; separate from ref/merge/publication operations.

documented_mechanisms.guarantee: Potential separate policy root when controlled by organization authority.
documented_mechanisms.limit: Documentation places organization rulesets on Enterprise; live organization is Free. Requires explicit external authority.

alternatives.name: operator_quiescence
alternatives.authority_required: Explicit owner/admin promise to stop all direct writers; lease/proxy/watchdog operation.
alternatives.exact_tree: Detect after merge by checking parents/tree; cannot make race impossible.

alternatives.name: non_bypass_ruleset_and_queue
alternatives.authority_required: Ruleset admin removes broad actor-5 bypass, adds exact check/workflow/queue rules, and proves merge_group CI in disposable fixture.
alternatives.exact_tree: Queue checks latest base/queue tree, not caller-pinned earlier base.

alternatives.name: existing_dedicated_updater_app
alternatives.authority_required: Explicit authorization for an already-installed narrowly permissioned App and matching update/bypass rules; no App creation here.
alternatives.exact_tree: Requires post-operation parent/tree verification; no base CAS.

alternatives.name: external_root_of_trust
alternatives.authority_required: Separate organization/repository owner or eligible organization-level ruleset controlled outside repository admin.
alternatives.admin_resistance: potentially_true only after provider configuration is independently proven
alternatives.exact_tree: Still requires a provider-supported integration contract; no current live proof.

preflight_assertions: Fail closed if an administrator remains able to bypass or edit the guard under the declared threat model.
Bind checks to exact integration IDs and workflows to path/ref/repository/sha.
For queue use, require merge_group trigger and prove required checks on synthetic queue SHA.
For direct updater use, identify an already-installed App and prove permissions/semantics in an isolated fixture.
Treat after-merge parent/tree comparison as detection and evidence, never retroactive CAS.
Preserve all platform and current-main obligations; no authority plan may narrow them.
